question: T1 random baseline changed from AP 0.052 (run 7) to 0.005 (run 8)
test_rows_identical: yes: the 4 test cases (biden-pardons, bubblemaps-military-cluster, kpmg-earnings-2025-26, us-iran-ceasefire-2026-04-07) were not touched by A18/A19; 102,109 rows, 32 positives in 20 markets in both runs
cause: pmitc_bench.py drew the training negative subsample from the seeded generator first (one draw per row of p, train and test), then the random scores. A19 removed the Spotify Wrapped rows from p (one documented wallet's markets), so the stream shifted and the test rows got different random scores. Same code, same test rows, a different draw.
why_so_variable: per-market AP is averaged per case; a few small test markets with one positive (121, 210, 214 rows) dominate: a random draw that puts that one positive near the top gives AP up to 1 for that market
bug: no metric bug; a fragile baseline. A23 drops it for the deterministic prevalence baseline (constant score)
